selection.reason_zh: PyOD v3.6.5 是本轮唯一达到专项阈值的 P2 到期对象。一手证据显示其对异常检测 Benchmark 数据生成与检测器行为存在实质变化；其 Benchmark Validity 机制可以独立复现，并可转化为有边界的评估实验，但不授权产品采用。

objects.name: yzhao062/pyod
objects.specialStudyTrigger: A method or evaluation change is directly applicable to Agent runtime anomaly signals.
objects.cadenceReason: First Sunday of September; monthly full review required against the 2026-08-16 monthly checkpoint.
objects.changeSummary: v3.6.5 materially repairs synthetic anomaly generation: the prior generator could draw offset_=0 and collapse every labelled outlier to the origin. Release evidence reports 46/501 affected seeds and several KNN ROC-AUC=0 cases; source and regression tests now repair the zero branch and validate spread/separation. ROD and CBLOF behavior/contracts also changed in bounded cases.
objects.changeSummary_zh: v3.6.5 对合成异常数据生成进行实质修复：旧生成器可能抽到 offset_=0，使全部标记 Outlier 塌缩到原点。Release Evidence 报告 501 个 Seed 中有 46 个受影响，并存在多个 KNN ROC-AUC=0 案例；源码与回归测试现已修复零偏移分支并验证 Outlier Spread/Separation。ROD 与 CBLOF 在有边界的场景中也发生行为/合同变化。
objects.judgment: The material lesson is benchmark validity, not PyOD adoption. An independent reproduction of the v3.6.4 source mechanism confirmed 46/501 seeds produce zero-variance labelled outliers. Agent-runtime anomaly evaluation should validate generated evidence before detector metrics are admitted as operational evidence.
objects.judgment_zh: 本次实质结论是 Benchmark Validity，而不是采用 PyOD。对 v3.6.4 源码机制的独立复现确认 501 个 Seed 中 46 个会产生零方差的标记 Outlier。Agent Runtime 异常评估在接纳 Detector Metric 为运行证据前，应先验证生成数据本身。
evidence: independent reproduction: 46/501 degenerate seeds in v3.6.4 mechanism

summary: All six registered P2 objects were due and resolved. One object, PyOD v3.6.5, reached 9/10 and triggered the single allowed full P2 Special Study; the study independently reproduced the old generator's 46/501 degenerate-seed mechanism and closed as Experiment Candidate. Aegis and agent-style changed only outside their declared trigger mechanisms and remain Continue Watching; agent-audit, cs-paper-checklist and anomaly-detection-resources had no material checkpoint change.
summary_zh: 6 个登记 P2 对象全部到期并全部收口。PyOD v3.6.5 以 9/10 达到阈值，触发本轮唯一允许的完整 P2 专项研究；专项独立复现旧生成器 46/501 的退化 Seed 机制，并以 Experiment Candidate 收口。Aegis 与 agent-style 的变化均未触及声明触发机制，继续观察；agent-audit、cs-paper-checklist 与 anomaly-detection-resources 检查点无实质变化。
